simple.meaning: שׁוּחָמִי (Shûwchâmîy) is a Hebrew word meaning “a Shuchamite (collectively).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: שׁוּחָמִי (H7749) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Numbers 26:42, with occurrences in Numbers.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שׁוּחָמִי (H7749) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in שׁוּחָמִי (H7749) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: שׁוּחָמִי (Shûwchâmîy) / H7749 is traced through Numbers 26:42, Numbers 26:43 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
